Acoustic Guitar (steel), from the Fluid (R3) General MIDI SoundFont by Frank Wen, as rendered to MP3 by
midi-js-soundfonts (https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts, FluidR3_GM/acoustic_guitar_steel-mp3), released
under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
Thirteen notes, E2 to E5 every minor third, unchanged.
